description: This Java class 'GeoWorker' provides utility methods for geographic data processing, including expanding geographic groups and regions, checking for geographic entities, and determining measurement systems based on locale.

classes.name: GeoWorker
classes.description: Final utility class containing static methods for geographic data operations.

methods.name: expandGeoGroup
methods.description: Expands a geographic group into its constituent geographies, handling nested groups.

methods.name: expandGeoRegionDeep
methods.description: Recursively expands geographic regions based on associations, returning a map of geo types to geo IDs.

methods.name: containsGeo
methods.description: Checks if a list of geographies contains a specific geo ID or geo value.

methods.name: findLatestGeoPoint
methods.description: Finds the most recent geographic point entity based on date and identifiers.

methods.name: getMeasurementSystem
methods.description: Determines measurement system (IMPERIAL or METRIC) based on locale.
